LNG_INFO_BANNER_SYNCED_DATA_PERSONS.translation: Cases, contacts, contacts of contacts and events

LNG_INFO_BANNER_SYNCED_DATA_PERSONS_DESC.translation: The records and the answers to their questionnaires.

LNG_INFO_BANNER_SYNCED_DATA_RELATIONSHIP.translation: Exposures and contacts between people, and the clusters they belong to.

LNG_INFO_BANNER_SYNCED_DATA_REFERENCE_DA.translation: Options available in the lists and the location hierarchy.

LNG_INFO_BANNER_SYNCED_DATA_LANGUAGES_DE.translation: Languages and the texts of the system, questionnaires and lists.

LNG_INFO_BANNER_SYNCED_DATA_USERS_DESCRI.translation: Users arrive without roles and with a random password; the other instance must set them before they can log in.

LNG_INFO_BANNER_SYNCED_DATA_TEMPLATES.translation: Templates and settings for import and filters

LNG_INFO_BANNER_SYNCED_DATA_TEMPLATES_DE.translation: Outbreak templates, icons, import mappings and saved filters.

LNG_INFO_BANNER_SYNCED_DATA_NOTE_CHANGES.translation: By default, only what was created, changed or deleted since the last successful synchronization is sent.

LNG_INFO_BANNER_SYNCED_DATA_NOTE_OUTBREA.translation: Only the data of the outbreaks allowed for the client credentials is sent.

LNG_PAGE_LIST_SYSTEM_UPSTREAM_SERVERS_IN.translation: Register here the other Go.Data instances (upstream servers, for example a central server) that this instance sends its data to, and control when the synchronization happens.
Add the URL of the other Go.Data instance and the client ID and secret generated there, in its "Receive data from servers" page.
Start it manually with the sync button (you can also send older data or everything), set an interval (in hours) for automatic sync, or enable "Sync on every change" to send changes as they happen.
This instance exports its data and sends it to the upstream server, which imports it. The first sync sends everything; the next ones send only what changed since the last successful sync.
The outcome (success, success with warnings or failed) is recorded in the "Track synchronization" page.
Synchronization is one-way: data is sent from this instance to the upstream server, not the other way around.

LNG_PAGE_LIST_SYSTEM_CLIENT_APPLICATIONS.translation: Here you create the credentials that let other systems connect to this instance and send data to it: another Go.Data instance that sends its data here (by registering this instance in its "Send data to servers" page), or the mobile app.
Give it a name. The client ID and secret can be generated automatically.
Limit which outbreaks the application can access. Leave it empty to allow all outbreaks.
Use the client ID and secret when registering this instance in "Send data to servers" on the other Go.Data, or download the configuration file (QR code) to set up the mobile app.
Requests are accepted only while the application is active and the credentials match. Deactivate it to block access without deleting it.
Treat the client secret like a password: anyone who has it can connect to this instance as that application.

LNG_PAGE_CREATE_SYSTEM_UPSTREAM_SERVER_C.translation: Connection established. The credentials were accepted, with access to all outbreaks.
Connection established. The credentials were accepted, with access to {{count}} outbreak(s).
Connection refused. Check the address and the port, and if the other instance is running.
Address not found. Check the name of the server.
The server did not respond in time.
Could not establish a secure connection: there is a problem with the SSL certificate of the server.
The address responded, but it does not look like a Go.Data server.
The server is online, but the credentials were rejected. Check the client ID and secret, and if the application is active on the other instance.
The server is online, but the API was not found at this address. The URL must end with /api.
Invalid URL. Use a complete address, for example http://localhost:3000/api.
Could not connect to the server.

LNG_PAGE_CREATE_SYSTEM_UPSTREAM_SERVER_U.translation: A server with this URL is already registered. To change it, use the pencil icon in the list, or use a different address.

LNG_PAGE_LIST_SYSTEM_UPSTREAM_SERVERS_SY.translation: The server is already up to date: there is no new data to send.

LNG_PAGE_MODIFY_SYSTEM_UPSTREAM_SERVER_N.translation: Upstream server not found. It may have been deleted.

LNG_PAGE_MODIFY_SYSTEM_UPSTREAM_SERVER_U.translation: The URL was changed. The synchronization history is kept by URL, so the next synchronization will send all the data to this new address.

LNG_UPSTREAM_SERVER_CONNECTION_CHECKING_.translation: Checking the server and its credentials...

LNG_PAGE_LIST_SYSTEM_UPSTREAM_SERVERS_SY.translation: Only what changed since the last synchronization: the usual option. Everything changed since a date: also sends older data, for example to fill a server that was recreated. All data: sends everything.
Only what changed since the last synchronization

Records created or updated since this date are sent. It only has effect if the date is older than the last successful synchronization; otherwise the last successful synchronization is used. If there was no successful synchronization yet, all the data is sent.

LNG_PAGE_LIST_SYSTEM_SYNC_LOGS_INFO_DESC.translation: Here you find the history of every synchronization of this instance: the data it sent to upstream servers and the data it received from other servers or from imported sync packages.

LNG_PAGE_LIST_SYSTEM_SYNC_LOGS_INFO_STEP.translation: A log is created when this instance sends data to an upstream server (the "Server URL" column is filled) or receives data from another server or an imported package (the "Client ID" column is filled).
In progress, Success, Success with warnings or Failed. The start and completion dates show how long it took, and the information start date shows from when the sent data was taken.
When a synchronization fails or has warnings, click the eye icon on the row to see the error details.
From the "Quick actions" menu you can set a backup to run before each synchronization, import or export a sync package (for instances that cannot reach each other) and delete old logs.

LNG_PAGE_LIST_SYSTEM_SYNC_LOGS_INFO_NOTE.translation: The last successful log of each server defines from when the next synchronization sends data. Deleting it doesn't change the data, but the next synchronization may send more records again.

LNG_PAGE_LIST_SYSTEM_UPSTREAM_SERVERS_SY.translation: Only the records created or updated since the last successful synchronization are sent. This is the usual option and the fastest one.
The records created or updated since the chosen date are sent. Use it to send older data again, for example to fill a server that was recreated.
All the data is sent. It may take a long time; the server only updates the records that are newer than the ones it already has.
There was no synchronization with this server yet, so all the data will be sent.
Filled with the outbreaks configured for the server. Leave it empty to send all the outbreaks.

The chosen outbreaks don't include all the ones configured for this server. This synchronization isn't used to determine what the next ones send, so they still send what changed in the outbreaks that were left out.

LNG_UPSTREAM_SERVER_FIELD_LABEL_OUTBREAK.translation: Leave it empty to synchronize all the outbreaks. The scheduled synchronizations and the ones made on every change send only the chosen outbreaks. When an outbreak is added, the next synchronization sends all the data of the chosen outbreaks.

LNG_SYNC_PROGRESS_DIALOG_PHASE_CONNECT.translation: Establishing the connection with the server...

LNG_SYNC_PROGRESS_DIALOG_PHASE_CREDENTIA.translation: Checking the client ID and secret...

LNG_SYNC_PROGRESS_DIALOG_PHASE_SEND.translation: Sending the data to the server...

LNG_SYNC_PROGRESS_DIALOG_PHASE_IMPORT.translation: The server is importing the data...

LNG_SYNC_PROGRESS_DIALOG_RESULT_WARNING_.translation: The data was synchronized, but some records had problems. See the details in Track synchronization.

LNG_SYNC_PROGRESS_DIALOG_RESULT_UP_TO_DA.translation: There was nothing new to send since the last synchronization.

LNG_SYNC_PROGRESS_DIALOG_ERROR_CONNECT.translation: It wasn't possible to connect to the server "{{name}}". Check if it is online and if the URL is correct.

LNG_SYNC_PROGRESS_DIALOG_ERROR_CREDENTIA.translation: The server "{{name}}" didn't accept the credentials. Check the client ID and secret in the server settings.

LNG_SYNC_PROGRESS_DIALOG_ERROR_SYNC.translation: An error occurred while synchronizing the data.

LNG_SYNC_PROGRESS_DIALOG_LOG_HELP.translation: If the problem continues, contact the system administrator or the person responsible for the destination server.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_TITLE_DE.translation: Demographic profile of the cases (sex and age) according to the dashboard filters. Cases classified as "Not a case" are not included.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_PERCENTA.translation: Percentages calculated over the total number of cases matching the dashboard filters.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_NO_DATA_.translation: No cases found for the selected filters

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_PYRAMID_.translation: Not included in the pyramid: {{count}} cases ({{percentage}}%) without age, without sex or with another sex category
The age pyramid requires the Male and Female sex categories, which are not available in this outbreak

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_NO_ONSET.translation: {{count}} cases with valid age but without date of onset are not shown in the boxplot by year

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_BOXPLOT_.translation: Age boxplot of the cases by year of symptom onset. Outliers follow Tukey's rule (1.5 x IQR). The mean and its 95% CI are calculated only for records with valid age.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_STAT_N_V.translation: Number of cases with a valid age (from 0 to 120 years). The percentage is calculated over all cases matching the dashboard filters.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_STAT_MEA.translation: Average age of the cases with valid age.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_STAT_CI_.translation: Range that contains the true mean age with 95% confidence. The narrower the range, the more precise the estimate of the mean.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_STAT_MED.translation: Age that divides the cases in half: 50% of the cases are younger and 50% are older.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_PROFILE_STAT_IQR.translation: Interquartile range: the 50% of the cases in the middle of the distribution are between these two ages (first quartile Q1 and third quartile Q3).

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_OVERVIEW_TOTAL_DESCRI.translation: Cases with date of symptom onset in the selected year, reported up to the reference date and matching the dashboard filters. Cases classified as "Not a case" are not included.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_OVERVIEW_CONFIRMED_DE.translation: Cases classified as Confirmed. The percentage is calculated over the total cases.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_OVERVIEW_INVESTIGATIO.translation: Cases not confirmed yet (for example suspect, probable or without classification). The percentage is calculated over the total cases.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_OVERVIEW_NEW_7_DAYS_D.translation: Cases of the selected year with date of reporting in the last 7 days, including the reference date (for a past year, the reference is December 31).

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_OVERVIEW_NEW_14_DAYS_.translation: Cases of the selected year with date of reporting in the last 14 days, including the reference date (for a past year, the reference is December 31).

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_OVERVIEW_CFR_DESCRIPT.translation: Deaths among confirmed cases divided by the number of confirmed cases, multiplied by 100.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_EPI_CURVE_TABS_TITLE_.translation: Evolution of the number of cases over time, by classification, by outcome and by reporting period. Each tab can be grouped by day, epidemiological week or month.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_EPI_CURVE_TABS_CUMULA.translation: Number of cases (discarded cases excluded) whose selected date falls in the selected year, up to the reference date of the dashboard.
New cases in the last period
Cases added to the curve in the most recent week, month or day displayed. The current period may still be incomplete.
New cases in the last period divided by the cumulative total before it, multiplied by 100. Shows how much the curve grew in the most recent period.
* Cumulative curve based on the selected time base. Discarded cases are not included. Values may change as records are updated.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_BY_GEOGRAPHIC_LO.translation: Top 10 locations (at the outbreak's reporting geographical level) ranked by number of cases. The percentage is each location's share of the total cases with a known location; it is not an incidence rate.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_DATA_QUALITY_TITLE_DE.translation: Assesses the completeness of the main information and the timeliness between investigation and follow-up steps.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_DATA_QUALITY_COMPLETE.translation: Proportion of records with the information filled in. The denominator only considers the records for which the information applies (discarded cases are not included).
Cases with the date of symptom onset filled in / total cases.
Cases with the classification filled in / total cases.
Cases with sex filled in / total cases.
Cases with age (years or months) or date of birth filled in / total cases.
Cases with a usual place of residence address with location filled in / total cases.
Cases with the outcome filled in / total cases.
Lab results of cases with the result filled in / lab results registered for cases. Each test counts once.
Contacts with at least one relationship registered with a case / total contacts.
* Applies only to lab results registered for cases (sample collected or test performed).
** Contacts with at least one relationship registered with a case / total contacts.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_KPI_CASES_NEW_PREVIOU.translation: Cases detected among known contacts in the last

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CASE_HOSPITALIZATION_.translation: Percentages are calculated over the total number of cases. A case may be counted in more than one category (e.g. hospitalized and isolated).

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CONTACT_FOLLOW_UP_TAB.translation: Shows the daily follow-up status of contacts and the cases according to their previous contact status.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CONTACT_PROFILE_TITLE.translation: Demographic profile of contacts (sex and age) according to the dashboard date and location filters. The classification filter does not apply to contacts.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CONTACT_PROFILE_PERCE.translation: Percentages calculated over the total number of contacts matching the dashboard filters.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CONTACT_PROFILE_NO_DA.translation: No contacts found for the selected filters

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CONTACT_PROFILE_PYRAM.translation: Not included in the pyramid: {{count}} contacts ({{percentage}}%) without age, without sex or with another sex category

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CONTACT_PROFILE_NO_RE.translation: {{count}} contacts with valid age but without date of reporting are not shown in the boxplot per year

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CONTACT_PROFILE_BOXPL.translation: Boxplot of contacts' age by year of reporting. Outliers follow Tukey's rule (1.5 x IQR). Mean and 95% CI are calculated only for records with valid age.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_CONTACT_PROFILE_STAT_.translation: Number of contacts with valid age (0 to 120 years). The percentage is calculated over the total number of contacts matching the dashboard filters.
Mean age of contacts with valid age.
Age that splits the contacts in half: 50% of contacts are younger and 50% are older.
Interquartile range: the middle 50% of contacts have an age between these two values (first quartile Q1 and third quartile Q3).

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_TRANSMISSION_CHAINS_T.translation: Number and size of independent chains of transmission according to the dashboard filters. Click a bar to see the chains of that size.

LNG_PAGE_DASHBOARD_TRANSMISSION_CHAINS_N.translation: The size of a chain is the number of records it contains. Click a bar to see the corresponding chains.
